page.notes: Left margin: "Pacta cum Westergoâ." (two lines, the second a hyphenated "Wester-goâ.") and "Nota." beside the italic passage. Small "»" marks stand in the left margin beside "lus exlex" and the line after it; they are not transcribed as text. The Greek word after "&" is worn; the reading ἀναρχ[?] is uncertain. The word "fa-dere" at the line end is uncertain, as is the reading "abstinerent" in the italic passage, which was split across the line. "Loi" is read as printed. The printed "majo-res" is a line-end hyphen; "res" at the foot is the catchword.
